The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Jadus]] organized a '''power base''' in the shadows<ref name="The Master's Enigma" /> by [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> It consisted of numerous [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolytes]] and [[Dark trooper (Darth Jadus)|soldiers]] and was used as Jadus's personal small army to further his personal agenda and plans.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />
